newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil privatizations seen at $14 bln in 97-Kandir.
newsitem.headline: Brazil privatizations seen at $14 bln in 97-Kandir.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said the government should earn $14 billion from privatizations in 1997, up from the government's target of $10 billion at the start of the year.
"Privatization is taking on an extraordinary speed," Kandir told reporters at a press conference at the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.
"No one can say the privatization program is proceeding slowly or with difficulties."

He said privatization receipts should increase to more than $30 billion in 1998 and remain around $30 billion in 1999 to bring the government's earnings from privatization to $74 billion in the next three years.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
